title: Metal–organic frameworks for the separation of xylene isomers
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,1613-1633
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00796D, Review Article
Ming Xu, Wen-Qi Tang, Sha-Sha Meng, Zhi-Yuan Gu
This review summarizes the recent progress in employing metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) as efficient separators for xylene isomers.
